notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «قالا جميعا حدثنا سليمان بن المغيرة»; the tail is written once
«أبو النضر، هاشم بن القاسم» is one man, a kunya and a name split by a comma (rule 7)
«وهذا حديث بهز» marks the matn as Bahz's version; «زاد ابن رافع» is a wording remark and is left out
Anas is the last link; the Prophet is not
